cards.question:
Running minimum

Scan a sequence once and track the smallest value seen so far.

Running maximum

Scan a sequence once and track the largest value seen so far.

Running sum

Maintain the cumulative sum of an array while scanning left to right.

Frequency table

Count the occurences of positive integers in an array (assume integers are bounded in range `[0, N)`)

First and second maximum

Scan an array while maintaining the two largest distinct values

Largest difference

Scan an array while maintaining the largest difference between the current element and all elements before it.

Cumulative subarray sum

Given an array `arr`, maintain an array `cumsum` where `cumsum[i]` contains the sum of `[arr[0], arr[i]]`.

Streak counting

Scan an array while maintaining the number of elements in the longest streak of increasing values.

Online running average

Maintain the online running average of the elements in an array
